inicio.kicker: Cinema with AI program · course 4 of 6 · 8 lessons
inicio.titulo: The video factory with agents: INEMA's open engines, from topic to published video
inicio.lead: Explainer with avatar, app demo, documentary, short with a quality gate, reel editor, and publishing. You run each INEMA engine on your machine, at a pinned commit, up to the point where it would spend credit, and stop there with the output checked.
inicio.capa_alt: Dark editing room with two monitors showing a timeline and code, a clapperboard, and a rack of computers; the course title is on the left.
inicio.aulas_sub: From the map to YouTube: explainer, demo, documentary, short, editing, avatar, and publishing.

itens: People who already use Claude Code or Codex in the terminal and want to produce video in series, not one at a time.
People who make video for a course, a company, or a channel and need to know which engine to use for each case.
People who want to understand an agent video pipeline from the inside: input, gates, and checked output.

blocos.t: What you'll be able to do
itens: Pick the right engine for what you have and what you want, with one command.
Assemble scenes and blocks of an explainer and capture an app demo click by click.
Reject an off-standard short and a pacing gap before rendering.
Put a consent gate before the avatar and rehearse publishing without sending anything.
Linux or macOS with git, Python 3 (with PyYAML and Pillow: pip install pyyaml pillow), Node 22 or newer, and FFmpeg. On Windows, use WSL.
Free space (estimate: about 2 GB): the render browser and the local voice download on first use. Lesson 3 uses agent-browser.
Recommended: course 3 (Motion by code), which teaches the HyperFrames these engines use.
